sources.ref: TANCHJIM Android app 2.5.7.4 (com.tanchjim.android): DSPCommand, FilterTypeMapping, CustomizeEffectsActivity

meta.notes: What Tanchjim's Android app does with its KT Micro devices (the app's "FeiFan" protocol; it tells them apart by USB product name only): 5 bands of peaking, low and high shelf, low-pass and high-pass, 30 to 20000 Hz in whole Hz, Q 0.1 to 10 and gain ±12 dB, both to one decimal. The app has no pre-gain and no EQ switch: it never reads or writes the slot register 0x24 or the preamp register 0x66. It writes the ten band registers 400 ms apart, then the commit, then closes the USB connection; it sends the commit and closes again when it goes to the background. On the FOLA, a write after a commit hangs until the device is opened again, so the bridge reconnects after each push (disconnectOnSave), as the app does. These are the app's editor limits, not verified firmware limits.
